scope: Research topic, inference limits, pre-output human gate and outcome-blindness

checks.name: rubric_matches_current_frozen_candidate
checks.evidence: No score, threshold, gold weights or new semantic labels introduced

checks.name: all11_pre_output_contrasts_per_split
checks.evidence: Avoid choosing source differences after seeing output

checks.name: comparison_categories_preserved
checks.evidence: Supports difference, similarity, noncomparability, insufficient evidence, uncertainty

checks.name: no_forced_success_requirement
checks.evidence: Human gate does not select E wins, diversity, or successful model outputs

checks.name: pre_output_pilot_and_main_gate_explicit
checks.evidence: The pre-output review gate applies to pilot as well as main. Content-neutral runtime diagnostics may precede it; research-output diagnostics must not be shown to reviewers.

checks.name: human_not_AI_and_not_samples
checks.evidence: Two distinct human readers complete their own forms before any corresponding v4.9.1 research outputs are viewed. This is quality control, not extra statistical samples.

checks.name: independent_originals_and_reconciliation
checks.evidence: Preserve originals, disagreements, unresolved findings; do not coerce agreement

checks.name: new_version_after_material_change
checks.evidence: After both forms are saved, compare all source and context findings and all 11 contrasts per split. Preserve both originals, disagreements, reconciliation rationale and unresolved items. Material input/rubric changes require a new version and renewed relevant review before generation.

checks.name: topic_evidence_to_decision_not_similarity
checks.evidence: Assess whether differing public organizational judgments survive as supported interpretations and allocation reasons. Different words or weights alone do not establish fidelity or harmful homogenization.

checks.name: machine_limit_explicit
checks.evidence: Machine checks can validate completeness and file identity, not certify that a human performed a review.

checks.name: current_readiness_not_overclaimed
checks.evidence: These are blank handoff materials; no human source judgment or research outcome has been invented

limits: These automated preparation checks do not complete independent human review.
No claims about browser visual layout, review quality, or human authenticity follow from these checks.
